job.job_description:
About us

Bain & Company is a global consultancy that helps the worlds most ambitious change makers define the future. Across 65 offices in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.

In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. BCN is an integral and largest unit of (ECD) Expert Client Delivery. ECD plays a critical role as it adds value to Bain's case teams globally by supporting them with analytics and research solutioning across all industries, specific domains for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property. The BCN comprises of Consulting Services, Knowledge Services and Shared Services.

About you

Design, build, and deploy agentic AI systems and LLM-powered applications that automate analytical and business workflows for AMS case teams
Develop and orchestrate multi-agent workflows using LangGraph, LangChain, and Azure AI Agent Service, integrating tools, memory, and reasoning loops
Build and optimize RAG pipelines, combining vector search with knowledge graphs where relevant
Engineer, evaluate, and refine prompts and LLMs, implementing guardrails, evaluation harnesses, and human-in-the-loop feedback for accuracy and safety
Build full stack applications end to end: responsive front-ends (React/TypeScript), backend APIs and services (Python, FastAPI), and database design (PostgreSQL/Snowflake)
Deploy, scale, and operate applications and AI workloads on Azure, optimizing for performance, cost, and reliability
Build and maintain CI/CD and MLOps/LLMOps pipelines using Docker and Git, with observability, logging, and monitoring of model quality, latency, and drift
Collaborate with product managers, data scientists, and consulting teams to translate business problems into scalable solutions
Provide technical thought leadership and may manage simple cases independently
May have first-level team management responsibility, including allocating and reviewing work for a small team of analysts and conducting performance/feedback discussions



Who you will work with




The Consumer Products Center of Expertise collaborates with Bains global Consumer Products Practice leadership, client-facing Bain leadership and teams, and with end clients on development and delivery of Bains proprietary CP products and solutions. These solutions aim to answer strategic questions of Bain’s CP clients relating to brand strategy (consumer needs, assortment, pricing, distribution), revenue growth management (pricing strategy, promotions, profit pools, trade terms), negotiation strategy with key retailers, optimization of COGS etc.

You will work as part of the team in CP CoE comprising of a mix of Director, Managers, Projects Leads, Associates and Analysts working to implement cloud-based end-to-end advanced analytics solutions. Delivery models on projects vary from working as part of a CP Center of Expertise, broader global Bain case team within the CP ringfence, or within other industry CoEs such as FS / Retail / TMT / Energy / CME / etc with BCN on need basis
